title: The signs keep pointing to the Raiders taking Fernando Mendoza

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: The signs keep pointing to the Raiders taking Fernando Mendoza
sources.description: With the odds all the way down to -20000 for quarterback Fernando Mendoza to be the first pick in the draft, there seems to be no way the Raiders won't be taking him.
